dialog: User: Hi, I recently read "Stranded with the SEAL (HERO Force)" and I really enjoyed it. [Review: I love a good Navy SEAL book. Trevor is on a mission when an unfortunate accident happens. Agent: Hello Deborah McClellan! I'm glad you enjoyed "Stranded with the SEAL (HERO Force)". It's definitely a great read. If you liked that book, I highly recommend "Arynn's Chosen Mate: Bad Alpha Dads (Iron Wolves MC)". [Review: This is one of Elle's best books yet. I love her Iron Wolves MC series and this story is just out of this world freaking good. Arynn and Sheila have a hard battle ahead of them because of members of her family who have kept secrets from her and her daughters. When Arynn comes to her home at her request to find out about his daughter, he feels things that don't make any sense. He was "brainwashed" into leaving his daughter all those years ago but now nothing is going to stop him from getting to know her. Will the secrets they both are hiding destroy them? Will her family finally get what they want through the girls? Oh, this intrigued me so much. I really, really loved seeing all my Iron Wolves and their mates, from the previous books show up to help this newly formed family out. Creed and Coti? What can I say, I need Coti's story now. When you go to read this book, just make sure you are not going to be interrupted because it's going to be hard to put down. Best book so far Elle!!! Keep it up!]

I love reading about shifters and this series started out that way. I enjoyed the first four books, hopefully the next one will be better. Sorry Elle.]

Agent: I understand your concerns about "Dark Lovers (Iron Wolves MC)". In that case, I recommend checking out "Arynn's Chosen Mate: Bad Alpha Dads (Iron Wolves MC)". It's a different book from the one you didn't enjoy. [Review: Review by Terri of Night Owl Reviews / 4.5 Stars / Top Pick OMG Talk about a paranormal treasure trove! From Hell to Heaven and plains in between, this story has tons of imagination. Each setting has wonderful descriptions of its landscape and its inhabitants. Some are places that you may have visited before in other books by Ms. Boon because there are several characters from her other books in this one. She has a wonderful way of meshing her books so that they intertwine. Its always a pleasure to see a loved character in a different setting. Raina and Creed are fantastic characters that are done with care. And, as in every book Ms. Boon writes, the sex is hot and there is a lot of it. However, don't expect Raina and Creed to jump right into bed as they have just met. Raina has no idea how she got to Hell nor how to get out of it. Creed never expected to find his Chosen in his fathers realm. Now, he has to figure out how to get them out of his fathers reach and then how to explain to Raina that she's his Chosen. Nothing like having to do the impossible! NOR voluntarily reviewed a reviewer copy.]
